author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Lightsaber Duels used to mean something.  The greatest Star Wars battles were never about flashy choreography or big set pieces, they were about emotion. Whether it was Obi-Wan sacrificing himself in A New Hope, Luke resisting the Dark Side in Return of the Jedi, or Obi-Wan and Anakin's heartbreaking clash in Revenge of the Sith, every swing of the lightsaber reflected the characters' inner conflict.

But over time, something changed. The fights became faster, bigger, and more technically impressive, but somewhere along the way, many of them lost the emotional storytelling that made them unforgettable.

So what happened? How did we get here?

#starwars #lightsaber #lucasfilm #filmhistory
title: Star Wars Has A Lightsaber Problem
